title: Rio Tinto 2025 full-year results
excerpt: For 2025 Rio Tinto reported USD 57.638 billion revenue, USD 25.363 billion underlying EBITDA, USD 16.832 billion operating cash flow, USD 4.025 billion free cash flow, USD 10.868 billion underlying earnings, USD 6.692 underlying EPS, and USD 14.362 billion net debt.
summary: The issuer release provides current full-year earnings, cash flow, capital expenditure, leverage, per-share earnings, dividend, and project milestones for a bounded cyclical valuation and balance-sheet review.
